description: How to rank LaunchTrace opportunities FOR one supplier prospect. Each profile says which buying-intent categories matter to that supplier, which product groups suit them best, and which launch stages are worth their time. Used by the prospect-specific preview generator so a pouch converter sees snack and bar brands, and a co-packer sees brands that need filling.
usage_note: Weights are relative and only decide ordering within a supplier's own shortlist. They never change the LaunchTrace Score itself, and they never let a suppressed or below-threshold opportunity into a preview.
score_weight_note: How much the underlying LaunchTrace Score contributes relative to supplier fit. Fit decides the shortlist; score breaks ties within it.

profiles.label: Flexible packaging manufacturer
profiles.line: Brands in this category normally commission printed film or pouches before their first production run.

profiles.label: Label or print supplier
profiles.line: Jarred, bottled and pot formats in this category need pressure-sensitive labels from the first batch onwards.

profiles.label: Carton and secondary packaging supplier
profiles.line: Retail-ready cartons and outer cases are usually the second packaging decision a brand in this category makes.

profiles.label: Food contract manufacturer
profiles.line: A brand filing at this stage is usually still deciding who will make the product at volume.

profiles.label: Co-packer
profiles.line: Filling, sealing and multipacking is typically outsourced by brands of this size rather than done in house.

profiles.label: Food distributor or wholesaler
profiles.line: Brands at this stage are looking for routes into independent retail and wholesale.

profiles.label: Broker or sales agency
profiles.line: A brand with a product but no buyer relationships is the case a broker is usually brought in for.

profiles.label: 3PL or ecommerce fulfilment provider
profiles.line: Direct-to-consumer despatch is usually outsourced once a brand starts shipping its own orders.

profiles.label: Food and FMCG marketing agency
profiles.line: Brand, pack design and launch marketing are commissioned around the point a trade mark is filed.

profiles.label: Other supplier to food brands
profiles.line: An early-stage UK food brand that has just protected its name.

preview.minimum_score_note: A preview lead must clear the MEDIUM band on its own merit. This is the delivered-product threshold, not a separate sales threshold, and lowering it to fill a preview is exactly the thing not to do.
preview.require_intent_note: The supplier's own primary category must be at least this relevant, or the lead does not belong in their preview.
preview.max_age_note: How old a published opportunity may be and still be worth showing. Raise it only when you have no recent run.
